description: Get detailed information (and optionally geometry/features) for a place. Provide either `id` (the `place_id` returned by geoapify_places) OR both `lat` and `lon`. Geoapify REST: GET /v2/place-details.

id.description: The Geoapify place id (pass the `place_id` value from geoapify_places).

lang.description: Result language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'.

name: geoapify_place_details
title: Place details
